# Vendored browser dependencies

`hls.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/hls.min.js` from the official
[`hls.js@1.7.3` npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/hls.js/-/hls.js-1.7.3.tgz).
Its SHA-256 is `a12e7ee1cd64a69dcdb314157e45dafcba705bfb0b1440b7935cb265d374423e`.
The package's SHA-512 integrity was verified before extraction. Its license is
in `hls.LICENSE`. Native HLS remains the Apple playback path.

Room-sync and native/Chromium comparison tests are documented in
[synchronization.md](../../docs/synchronization.md).
